coverage.reason: Says the waived amount is forgone and describes the waiver as a permanent fee cut.
Gives a 36-month recoupment period and says recovery is limited by the lower of the original and current caps.

local_error: “unitary waivers are a permanent fee cut” — stated categorically, this generalizes beyond the described arrangement; contract terms control.
rationale: Both required points are covered, but the categorical claim about all unitary waivers is an unsupported generalization and caps the grade at partial.
